source.fonts: self-hosted variable Archivo 400–700 and JetBrains Mono 400–600, Latin subset

ink-wash.note: alpha wash over paper; no ramp

red-wash.note: alpha wash over paper; no ramp

green-wash.note: alpha wash over paper; no ramp

slate-wash.note: alpha wash over paper; no ramp

display.purpose: The four disposition numerals (30px, 24px under 960px). The Read register h2 uses the same size at 700; the welcome title is 28px.

headline.purpose: The wordmark; gate and Read h3 titles at 18–19px/700.

title.purpose: The chart's one-sentence title, balanced wrap.

subtitle.purpose: Data log title and inspector idle title (700).

body.purpose: The 14px base; table cells 13.5px, controls 13px, notes 12.5px.

reading.purpose: Science and Try it prose at 15px/1.7 in a 68ch column; the premise at 15px in a 56ch measure.

label.purpose: Chart group titles, table headers, verdict words. Never uppercased; no eyebrows.

measure.purpose: Cell IDs, probabilities, deltas, chemistry codes, key-value figures. Only for measured or computed values.

measure-large.purpose: Transfer result and reading stats at 26px; inspector title 16px; mode name 18px.

axis.purpose: Chart tick labels at 11px in muted; axis titles and series labels are Archivo 11px.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: The only lift: inspector, TRY IT result panel, welcome dialog, chart tooltip.

shadows.name: sheet-shadow
shadows.purpose: The phone bottom sheet, cast upward.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Search field focus, with an ink border. All other focus is outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every arrival, hover and selection transition.

motion.name: arrival-line
motion.purpose: The decision line draws left to right (stroke-dashoffset) on first fleet render.

motion.name: arrival-bars
motion.purpose: Interval bars scaleY from the decision line in a 4ms stagger; points appear at 0.75s, pennants drop at 0.95s.

motion.name: arrival-disposition
motion.value: appear 0.5s ease-out, delay 1.05s + i*60ms; budget-used transition 0.9s at 1.2s
motion.purpose: Counters fade in after the chart; the budget bar fills last.

motion.name: arrival-rows
motion.purpose: Log rows cascade in with a 6px rise.

motion.name: select-ring
motion.value: draw-ring 0.35s ease-out; drop line appear 0.3s at 0.15s
motion.purpose: The ink pen circle draws on around the selected point, then the hairline drops to the baseline.

motion.name: select-underline
motion.purpose: The selected row's 1.5px ink underline scales in from the left.

motion.name: sharpen
motion.value: 0.5s ease-out; opacity 0 + blur(6px) + translateY(8px) to rest; 40ms stagger per inspector child
motion.purpose: Inspector sections, gates, reading blocks and the welcome dialog arrive blur-to-sharp.

motion.name: counter-roll
motion.purpose: A disposition numeral changes by cross-fade with a 4px roll; never a wrong intermediate number.

motion.name: hover-dim
motion.purpose: Hovering one bar dims every other bar; tooltip follows on a lerp.

motion.name: tab-switch
motion.purpose: Tab panes swap through document.startViewTransition; plain swap fallback.

motion.name: theme-reveal
motion.purpose: Theme toggle reveals the new theme as a circle expanding from the toggle button.

motion.name: sheet-slide
motion.purpose: The phone inspector sheet slides up on selection.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): every animation and View Transition off; scroll-behavior auto
motion.purpose: All motion collapses to a static render; the JS REDUCED flag also skips View Transitions and smooth scroll.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.note: Header stacks, tabs scroll, chart 200px tall, disposition two-column, inspector becomes bottom sheet, optional log columns hide, gutter 48px -> 20px.

breakpoints.name: chart-narrow
breakpoints.note: Group labels shorten, per-bar pennants withheld, one clustered pennant with count; refusal flags keep full size.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled pill: ink on paper, used for the welcome dialog's main action.

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Bare muted text that turns ink and underlines on hover; the secondary actions beside a primary.

components.name: Fleet Switch
components.description: Pill segmented control; the pressed segment is filled ink with paper text.

components.description: Bare text tabs; the active tab is ink with a 2px underline that scales in from the left and closes the header rule.

components.css: .ds-form-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #1a1a17); } .ds-tab { font-family: var(--sans, "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif); position: relative; padding: 12px 14px 16px; border: none; background: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted, #62635c); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-tab::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; bottom: -1px; height: 2px; background: var(--ink, #1a1a17); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.35s var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-tab:hover, .ds-tab.active { color: var(--ink, #1a1a17); } .ds-tab.active::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #1a1a17); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Control Chart"**

Hectocycle is one Shewhart control chart, and everything else on the page is the chart's paperwork. The fleet of held-out cells sits as interval bars on a shared 0 to 1 rail with the decision line drawn across it; a bar that clears the line is a call, a bar that straddles it wears a red pennant, and a cell the model refuses to score is a red-hatched column, the loudest mark on the page. The ground is plain cream chart paper in light and matte black in dark, with no grid, no texture and no pattern behind the data. Density is high but calm: one hairline rule separates the chart from the disposition line, one separates the log from its header, and the inspector is the only surface that lifts off the paper.

Colour is a signal, never decoration. There are exactly four meanings: green for a cleared pass or a positive result, red for an alarm and nothing else, neutral ink for text and every interaction state, and gray for waiting. Four chemistry hues are categorical and keep clear of all four meanings so no chemistry ever impersonates a status. Archivo carries every UI role at four weights; JetBrains Mono appears only where a measurement or a cell ID is being read. Numerals are tabular everywhere, so counts and hours never jitter as they change.

Motion is a single arrival choreography (the decision line draws, the bars rise from it, the flags drop, the counters and rows follow) plus one selection signature (an ink pen circle draws around the chosen point, a hairline drops to the baseline, the inspector sharpens in). Tabs and the theme toggle use the View Transitions API, the theme as a circular reveal from the toggle. Every motion collapses to a static render under `prefers-reduced-motion`. Confirmed rejections: the KPI-tally dashboard, decorative gradients, background grids, eyebrows and section numbers, cards inside cards, and any number shown for a refused cell.
keyCharacteristics: One chart is the page; tables, counters and the inspector serve it
Cream paper (#f7f4ea) or matte black (#121212), never patterned, never hue-cast
Four colour meanings (green cleared, red alarm, ink neutral, gray waiting) plus a categorical chemistry quartet
Archivo for every UI role; JetBrains Mono for measurements and IDs only; tabular numerals throughout
1px hairline rules, 4px panel corners, 999px pills; depth by one soft lift on the inspector
One arrival choreography, one selection signature, all reduced-motion aware

rules.name: The Four Meanings Rule
rules.body: Green means cleared or positive, red means alarm, ink is the neutral voice, gray means waiting. A colour that appears without one of these four meanings is a defect. Chemistry hues are categorical and never carry a status.

rules.name: The Ink Interaction Rule
rules.body: Selection, focus, hover and the decision line are ink, never red and never green. Red is spent only on things that must be acted on: a straddled interval, a refusal, a limit, an error.

rules.name: The Plain Paper Rule
rules.body: The ground is one flat colour: cream in light, matte black in dark. No grid, no noise, no gradient, no hue cast behind the data.

rules.name: The Mono Is A Measurement Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only on a value that was measured, computed or identifies a cell. Prose, labels, buttons and headings never use it.

rules.name: The One Scale Step Rule
rules.body: The only large type on the Fleet surface is the four disposition numerals at 30px. Nothing else on that surface exceeds 20px; the chart title is 18px so the chart stays the largest thing.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the surface that holds the selected cell (inspector, result panel, dialog, tooltip) lifts off the paper. Bands, tables, counts and charts stay flat and are separated by rules.

dos: Do keep the page ground one flat colour: cream (#f7f4ea) in light, matte black (#121212) in dark, no grid, gradient or texture.
Do spend red only on alarms: a straddle pennant, a refusal hatch, a limit line, an error or a shortfall against spec.
Do use ink for every interaction state: selection ring, drop line, row underline, focus outline, hover border, pressed segment.
Do set every measurement, probability, delta and cell ID in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals, and everything else in Archivo.
Do separate bands with 1px rules (`rule` for hairlines, `ink` for structural edges) and give panels 4px corners and pressable controls 999px pills.
Do lift only the surface that holds the selected cell (inspector, result panel, dialog, tooltip) with the Lift shadow.
Do run motion once as arrival (line draws, bars rise, flags drop, counters and rows follow) and once as selection; collapse all of it under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do keep the refused mark at full size on every breakpoint and cluster straddler pennants into one flag with a count when the chart is narrow.
donts: Don't show a number for a refused cell; a refusal is a hatched column, a pennant and the out-of-range feature's name.
Don't let a chemistry hue read as a status: the quartet stays clear of green and red and never fills a verdict.
Don't use green as the interval fill for anything but a cleared pass, or use fill green for type (use `green-text`).
Don't add eyebrows, kickers, section numbers, uppercase labels or cards inside cards.
Don't add a second lift, a hard offset shadow, a glow or a hover shadow; hover is a border change and a 1px rise.
Don't let a masthead tally or an accuracy scorecard become the largest type on a surface; the 30px disposition numerals are the one scale step.
Don't introduce custom cursors, split-text reveals, parallax, magnetic buttons or marquees.
